 Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Shalinder Kaur
 Order

The present petition has been filed by the petitioners under Section 528 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 seeking to quash the FIR No. 743/2021 dated 06.09.2021 for the offences under Sections 498A, 406 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 registered at Police Station Dabri,
Delhi and all consequential proceedings arising therefrom.
2. Due to a Farewell Reference today, it would not be possible to take up this petition for hearing today.

3. Re-notify on 11.09.2025.
SHALINDER KAUR, J MAY 30, 2025/
